listing.descriptionMarkdown:
## New in 2.6.3: Camera filters are here!

Give your captures a new look with three camera filter styles, including Matrix. The Camera interface also has clearer, easier-to-read controls.

Wi-Fi Drop now supports uploading APKs to your glasses. Open the uploaded APKs in File Explorer to install them, or install apps from the Manager App Store. Wi-Fi Drop also has a redesigned browser interface and transfer reliability fixes.

AI Glasses Manager (formerly Rokid Manager) is an independent, on-device utility suite that unlocks advanced hardware controls and stability fixes for your AR glasses. Manage your apps, wirelessly transfer files, and access hidden camera tools directly on your device without needing a phone companion. Developed by Bruce. Includes a 3-day free trial, followed by a $1.99 one-time purchase per device.

## Features

- Three camera filter styles, including Matrix, plus camera tools and photo and video viewing
- Built-in Manager updates after the initial installation
- On-device App Store with app update detection and download controls
- File browsing, APK installation in File Explorer, and wireless file transfers with APK uploads through Wi-Fi Drop
- Separate volume controls and shortcuts to frequently used tools

## Requirements

Designed for Rokid AI Glasses. No phone companion app is required.

The current app uses a different Android package from Rokid Manager 1.5 and installs separately. Download official builds and read the release notes on the linked GitHub repository.
